security_implications: This chunk directly drives cipher_key_clear_o, cipher_data_out_clear_o, key_iv_data_in_clear_we_o, data_out_clear_we_o (key/data wipe), alert_o, and PRNG reseed signals. The OR reduction on alert/clear outputs means any single asserted rail immediately triggers these security‑critical actions; this is fail‑safe against stuck‑low faults but vulnerable to false triggers from glitches or compromised rails. The AND reduction on write‑enable signals requires full rail consensus, which prevents spurious writes but may block necessary clears if one rail fails low, potentially leaving secrets exposed. The chunk itself contains no error detection or glitch filtering on the multi‑rail buses, shifting the entire integrity burden to the source FSM.
